preconditions.description: The integer n must be between 1 and 100000.
The length of the permutation must equal n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation)
preconditions.description: All elements in the permutation must be integers between 1 and n.
All elements in the permutation must be unique.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'ambiguous' if permutation == inverse_permutation else 'not ambiguous'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'ambiguous' if the permutation is the same as its inverse, otherwise 'not ambiguous'.
